programme.title: Dum 3
programme.desc: While on his way to sell his family property in a village, a young man has to face unexpected challenges when he falls in love with a woman, who is the daughter of his ancestor's sworn enemies.

programme.title: Sethupathi
programme.desc: Sethupathi, a tough police officer, investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of Vathiyar, an influential man in Madurai, but put his life, career and family at risk.

programme.title: Kanchana 3
programme.desc: Raghava, a cheerful young man living happily with his family, has a deep fear of ghosts. However, during a visit to Coimbatore, he becomes possessed by a vengeful spirit with a sinister past.

programme.title: Kartik Ka Badla

programme.title: Super Khiladi 4
programme.desc: A simple young man, falls in love with a woman at first sight. However, he is disheartened after finding that the girl's father has arranged her wedding elsewhere.

programme.title: Aathi

programme.title: Veera
programme.desc: Shyam Prasad is an honest police officer who creates problems for a local don. When the don threatens to kill his family, Deva is assigned to protect Shyam's family and bring the don to justice.

programme.title: Karthikeya
programme.desc: A medical student, Karthikeya, visits Subramaniyapuram for a medical camp. However, when he learns about the mystery surrounding the temple of Kumara Swami, he decides to investigate it.

programme.title: Stalin
programme.desc: Stalin, a former army officer, is deeply moved by the suicide of a girl with physical disabilities. So, he devises a plan to extend unconditional help to those who need it to establish peace.
